record.paper: Triangle-free subgraphs with large fractional chromatic number

dossier_meta.paper: Triangle-free subgraphs with large fractional chromatic number
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every real number $x \geq 1$ and any integer $g \geq 3$, there exists a positive number $k(x,g)$ such that every graph $G$ with $\chi_f(G) \geq k(x,g)$ contains a subgraph $H$ of girth at least $g$ and with $\chi_f(H) \geq x$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Proposed immediately after Theorem 3 as the natural full generalisation to arbitrary girth. Theorem 3 of this paper establishes the case $g = 4$ (triangle-free subgraphs), and Conjecture 4 asks whether the same holds for every girth.
